verdict.rationale: Salesforce advertises a set of APIs and ships an official CLI covering data queries, scratch-org creation, Apex test runs and agent create/activate, plus an official MCP server. A community comment calls the CLI a 'passable command line tool' alongside other developer tooling. This shows broad programmatic access, but nothing in the evidence documents that the API matches everything the UI can do. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 on the marketing domain is not a concrete contradiction of API coverage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, API reference coverage of Sales Cloud features (forecasting, quoting, lead routing), a discoverable machine-readable API spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
